$comment: Forge data the engine embeds, packed by engine/scripts/pack-resources.mjs from the pinned Forge commit with the original paths below forge-gui/ (res/...). Every entry of forge-gui/res at the pin must appear here, either in include or in leftOut, each with a reason: a Forge update that brings a new entry stops the build until someone decides. Evidence for the choices (which files Forge reads during start and games): docs/implementation/04-forge-resources-card-scripts.md. Change only together with that document.

include.reason: Every card script, not filtered by deck: effects such as MakeCard, CopyPermanent or Play bring cards into the game that are in no deck. Even lazy loading parses all of them once at start to build the name index.
Every token script; Forge reads all of them at start.
Editions: printings, set codes and collector numbers (Arena import), token printings, release dates (upcoming sets). Read at start.

Format definitions (legality). Forge reads the sanctioned and casual formats at start; archived formats and blocks only with LOAD_ARCHIVED_FORMATS or for Limited, kept so the format model is complete (text, compresses to almost nothing).

TypeLists.txt and NonStackingKWList.txt (card types and keywords, read at start: without them legality changes), the achievement lists Forge reads at the end of a game, the Commander bracket lists. The rest are image and deck download lists; kept to preserve the directory as upstream ships it.
Blocks, boosters and print sheets: not read in constructed games today, needed for sealed/draft and booster effects (MakeCard Booster$). Text, small.
Forge's AI profiles (Default, Cautious, Reckless, Experimental; Bible §7).
Forge's English messages; always loaded, also as the fallback of every other language.
Forge's German messages (prompts, buttons, game log): Bible §4 prefers German. Selected with the boot argument --language=de-DE.
German card names inside Forge's messages and game log (with --language=de-DE). Card keys stay English; card display comes from Scryfall.

leftOut.reason: Only English and German are part of OpenMana (Bible §4); the other languages are left out.
Two GIF animations of Forge's mobile UI (read only by forge-gui-mobile). 1.6 MB that do not compress (about 12 % of the engine download) and that the engine never reads.
Window layouts and placeholder images of Forge's desktop UI, defaults of gauntlet and tournament modes. The engine never reads them.
Where Forge looks for card pictures; OpenMana's pictures come from Scryfall.
Card-based deck generator; the engine sets DECKGEN_CARDBASED=false, decks always come from the player.
Decks for Forge's AI deck generation experiments; not used.
Forge's Adventure mode (a separate game).
Forge's Planar Conquest mode.
Forge's Quest mode.
Forge's puzzle mode.
Forge's own tutorial.
Cube lists for Limited; not part of OpenMana's first scope (add with Limited).
Draft rankings for Limited; not part of OpenMana's first scope (add with Limited).
Sealed pools for Limited; not part of OpenMana's first scope (add with Limited).
Forge's UI skins.
Forge's UI fonts.
Forge's sounds; sound belongs to the OpenMana UI.
Forge's music.
License texts of Forge's third-party libraries; they belong to the credits and notices of the app (prompt 27), not to the running engine.
Help text of Forge's UI.
